body:
Found while checking PR #7 (merge tree 9307838eb7) on 2026-11-14.

`cargo nextest run -p language` on Windows: 90 of 156 tests abort with 0xc0000005. The crash also happens on origin/main 50ee54c4c0, on c66b2623ba (before the fix) and on d0263f83f8 (the fix itself).

`script/check-unresolved-pointers.py` on the debug test binary (target/debug/deps/language-*.exe) reports 48 unresolved pointer slots holding the image base in .rdata. That matches the 48 `wasm*` symbols that `wasmtime_c_api_keepalive.rs` keeps alive. The release thin-LTO zed.exe from the same tree has 0 bad slots and runs fine. So the keepalive fixes the LTO image, but debug (non-LTO) test binaries still resolve these imports to RVA 0. Every `with_parser` call reaches `WasmStore::new`, so any test that parses crashes.

The linker prints LNK4217 (locally defined symbol imported) for each symbol in the debug link too. The slots still end up as zero.

comments.body: Changed: commit f84fec8f1f on af/zed-1nseh-windows-debug-test-binaries-cras, PR #8, stacked on #7 (base fix/zed-brand-logomark-icon). with_parser now calls wasmtime_c_api_keepalive::keep_alive(), which black_boxes KEEP_WASMTIME_C_API. Root cause: rust-lld's synthesized __imp_ pointers (LNK4217) don't keep their targets alive, so /OPT:REF dropped the wasm* definitions and the #[used] static. The linker map shows the 48 __imp_wasm* slots, and /OPT:NOREF fixes it. Verified: nextest -p language 156/156, pointer check 0 slots on the debug test binary, clippy -p language and rustfmt clean. Still to do: a release build plus pointer check of this exact commit is running detached in worktree <path>, logging to the scratchpad file summary4.log. Retarget PR #8 to main after #7 merges. Gotchas: extension_cli creates its own WasmStore outside with_parser (not checked). Builds here have crashed rustc under memory pressure when other sessions build in parallel, so use -j 6.

Done. f84fec8f1f on af/zed-1nseh-windows-debug-test-binaries-cras, PR #8 (stacked on #7, base fix/zed-brand-logomark-icon). Verified on this commit: nextest -p language 156/156; pointer check 0 slots on the debug language test binary, on the release zed.exe and on the debug zed-extension.exe; release zed.exe opened a Rust file and stayed up 45 s with no panics; clippy -p language and rustfmt clean. Left: retarget PR #8 to main after #7 merges. Gotcha: on this machine rustc crashed (0xc0000005, 0xc0000374) on leftover output from crashed builds. cargo clean -p zed -p tab_switcher for the release target fixed it.

body: From PR #16 (zephyr ticket zed-fee3f). Seen on the deployed build 4f71b6d554 (2026-11-21): clicking Dependency Licenses in About Synth Code closes the About window and nothing opens. The log shows "ERROR [crates/gpui/src/app.rs:2395] window not found" at the click. The on_click handler (crates/zed/src/zed.rs, "dependency-licenses") calls cx.dispatch_action(&OpenLicenses), which updates the active window, the About window itself, while its own event handler holds it, so the update fails and the action is dropped. Dispatching through window.dispatch_action would be deferred onto the About window, which the same handler then removes. The palette command "zed: open licenses" works. Fix: open the licenses in an existing workspace window (find a MultiWorkspace among cx.windows(), else fall back to the global action), then close About.
title: About > Dependency Licenses closes the window but never opens the licenses

Found while checking PR #7 on 2026-11-14. None of these are in files PR #7 touches, and all fail the same way on origin/main.

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`: diffs in ai_onboarding.rs, young_account_banner.rs, edit_prediction_button.rs, language_models/provider/cloud.rs, terminal/alacritty/hyperlinks.rs and zed/open_listener.rs. These came from the rebrand commits.
- `./script/clippy`: `clippy::redundant_clone` at crates/zed/src/reliability.rs:23. It was introduced by 44d6d4a01b or 2a60ab4b75.
- `script/clippy.ps1` returns exit 0 even when clippy fails, because it doesn't propagate `$LASTEXITCODE`.
- `script/check-todos` flags `.agent/backlog/items.md:10`.
- `./script/prettier` flags `assets/settings/default.json` and 286 docs files. Some of these may be CRLF checkout artifacts (core.autocrlf=true).
- `script/check-licenses` fails on Windows checkouts because core.symlinks=false. In the git index all 248 LICENSE files are symlinks (mode 120000).
